summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 8, 2026, disclosing that the Government of Ghana extended the Abirem and Miradani Mining Leases at the Asanko Gold Mine. Abirem runs 15 years through 2041 and Miradani 17 years through 2043, covering the Nkran, Adubiaso and Miradani North deposits, the 5.8 Mtpa processing facility and Nkran Cut 3. No price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is stated; the item is a routine operational/regulatory lease extension, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply.
